summary: A member wants the meeting details in the message so nobody has to open an attachment.
realLife: Colt Rodeman asked the Converse County party to put the meeting time and location directly in its email notice.
inGame: needs: a meeting notice, its body and the confirmed time and place.

turns.what: The address goes into the message itself.
turns.pulledBy: The secretary has the room booking before sending the notice.
turns.writesBack: A member can find the meeting from the email alone.

turns.what: The secretary sends the corrected location in the message body.
turns.pulledBy: The room changes after the message goes out.
turns.writesBack: The calendar points to the replacement room.
